name: 8th & B Poke
notes: All 3 photos show the same in-store Vestaboard flip-sign menu (build-your-own poke), photographed on different visits. Base poke bowl sizes, poke-only container sizes, and drink prices were consistent/legible across photos and included as dishes. Protein flavor boards (Ahi/Tuna, Salmon, Tako, Yellowtail) list topping/sauce options with no individual prices and rotate between photos, so treated as modifiers per the extraction rules and omitted, as was the explicitly-labeled ADD-ONS board (tempura, spam, sausage, etc).
